maddeler.e:
اطمئن (form IVq)
# اُطْمُئِنَّ (uṭmuʔinna) /utˤ.mu.ʔin.na/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
# اِطْمَئِنَّ (iṭmaʔinna) /itˤ.ma.ʔin.na/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
# اِطْمَئِنِّ (iṭmaʔinni) /itˤ.ma.ʔin.ni/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
